Urology & Stone Care

Best Urology Hospital in Ranchi offering comprehensive urological care for adults and children with advanced medical technology.

Overview

Raj Hospitals is committed to providing compassionate and timely care for disorders of the urinary system. Our skilled urologists offer diagnosis and treatment for a wide range of urological diseases including urinary tract infections, kidney stones, urologic cancers, infertility, and male reproductive issues. The department is equipped with cutting-edge technology delivering expert adult and pediatric urology care and minimally invasive surgical options.

Why Choose Our Urology Department

  • Experienced team of urologists and uro-oncosurgeons
  • Advanced laser and lithotripsy technology for kidney stones
  • Minimally invasive and robotic-assisted surgeries
  • Comprehensive care for male infertility and sexual health

Key Facilities

Advanced endoscopic and laparoscopic surgical suites
Robotic surgical system for precision treatments
Dedicated dialysis access and renal transplant support
Comprehensive diagnostic imaging and laboratory services
Specialized pediatric urology care
Multidisciplinary urology team for holistic management

Conditions We Treat

Common conditions we diagnose and treat in our Urology department

Kidney Stones (Urolithiasis)
Urinary Tract Infections (UTI)
Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH)
Prostate Cancer
Bladder Cancer
Kidney Cancer (Renal Cell Carcinoma)
Erectile Dysfunction
Male Infertility
Urinary Incontinence
Overactive Bladder (OAB)
Testicular Cancer
Varicocele
Hydrocele
Urethral Stricture
Pelvic Organ Prolapse
Penile Disorders
Pediatric Urological Conditions
Hematuria (Blood in Urine)

Treatments We Offer

Advanced treatments for all urological conditions

Prostate Surgeries (TURP)

Treatment for benign prostatic hyperplasia and related conditions using Transurethral Resection of Prostate.

Kidney Stone Surgeries

Minimally invasive and surgical removal of kidney and bladder stones.

Female Urology Surgeries

Treatment for female urinary tract conditions including incontinence and prolapse.

Infertility Treatment

Care and surgical management of male and female infertility in the reproductive age group.

Lithotripsy

Non-invasive shock wave therapy for breaking down kidney stones.

Robotic Surgery

Advanced robotic-assisted surgical techniques for precision and quicker recovery.

Renal Transplantation

Comprehensive pre-op and post-op care and surgery for kidney transplant patients.

Laparoscopic Surgery

Minimally invasive surgeries for urological conditions including tumors and reconstructions.

Uro-Oncology

Management of urological cancers including bladder, prostate, and renal tumors.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about urology and kidney health

What urological conditions are treated?

Urinary infections, stones, cancers, infertility, erectile dysfunction, and pediatric urology conditions.

Is robotic surgery available?

Yes, we offer robotic-assisted surgeries for precision and faster recovery.

Do you perform kidney transplants?

Yes, including pre and post transplantation comprehensive care.

Are pediatric urology services offered?

Our team specializes in managing congenital and acquired urological conditions in children.
